programme.title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
programme.desc: After the loss of his best friend on Christmas Eve, Bobby goes out onto the lake and makes a shocking discovery. When the land is bought, Bobby must rally the town to save it.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: Hello Carter
programme.desc: This witty, charming, feel-good comedy, stars Jodie Whittaker (Doctor Who) and Charlie Cox (Daredevil). Carter is a homeless, unemployed, single, twenty-something Londoner. Desperate to get his life back on track, he wants to win back his elusive ex-girlfriend Kelly (Annabelle Wallis), but learns that the road to happiness can be unpredictable, unconventional and unbelievably funny.

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: Heart-warming and hilarious, this family tale stars Academy Award nominee Clive Owen (Children of Men) and Maria Bello (A History of Violence). Walt, a down-on-his luck carpenter, is tasked with entertaining his eight-year-old son Anthony. But when Walt's prized toolbox is stolen, a quiet father-and-son weekend turns into an adventure of a lifetime. This sincere story of fatherhood is a must see!

programme.title: Black Medicine
programme.desc: A suspenseful thriller, set in the heart of the Irish crime underbelly, starring Amybeth McNulty (Anne with an E), Orla Brady (Fringe) and Antonia Campbell-Hughes (Kelly + Victor). Jo is a black-market medic who carries out illegal operations for the criminal underworld. When she gives refuge to a young girl, she must choose between breaking her medical oath or crossing her ruthless employers.

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: Orlando Bloom (The Pirates of the Caribbean) and Simon Yam ( Ip Man) star in this high-octane heist action film from the team behind Iron Man 3. After messing up a job, security agent Danny is now working on low-level body guarding jobs. Soon he has the chance to redeem himself and escort a valuable Chinese antique out of Shanghai, but the story takes a turn when he is ambushed en route. Intense!

programme.title: The Toll
programme.desc: An irresistibly clever, darkly-comic crime caper, reminiscent of the Coen brothers finest work. Starring Michael Smiley (Luther), Annes Elwy (Little Women) and Iwan Rheon (Game Of Thrones). A man working solo in the quietest toll booth in Wales hides from a criminal past. As his past catches up with him, he enlists the help of local oddballs when police grow increasingly suspicious.

programme.title: A Rainy Day in New York
programme.desc: Woody Allen's romantic comedy A RAINY DAY IN NEW YORK tells the story of college sweethearts, Gatsby (Timothée Chalamet) and Ashleigh (Elle Fanning), whose plans for a romantic weekend together in New York City are dashed as quickly as the sunlight turns into showers.

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: A divorced father and his eight-year-old son, spend a rather predictable weekend together, but when a valuable toolbox gets stolen, the search for the thieves will turn into a true family bonding.

programme.title: The Ark
programme.desc: The Ark is a retelling of the biblical story of Noah and The Ark. Noah, a farmer and family man, is instructed by an angel to build an ark in the middle of a desert in order to save both his family and the faithful from a devastating flood.

programme.title: Addition
programme.desc: Grace counts everything because numbers hold her world together, but a chance encounter with Seamus unravels her meticulously ordered life.

programme.title: When We Get There
programme.desc: Two brothers set out on a 2,000-mile road trip to find their father, confronting uncertain futures, fragile relationships and the meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: A Christmas Duet
programme.desc: (2019) Joyful romance with Chaley Rose. While prepping her inn for the annual Yuletide festival, Averie has an unexpected reunion with her old musical partner. Can they strike the right note together?

programme.title: A Very Country Christmas
programme.desc: (2017) Festive romance with Greyston Holt. A singer escapes the chaos of Hollywood to rediscover his love for country music. But what he stumbles upon is even better.

programme.title: Memories Of Christmas
programme.desc: (2018) Festive romance with Christina Milian. Noelle returns to her hometown to inherit her Christmas obsessed late mother's house. Can she rediscover her love of the season and maybe more?

programme.title: Merry Mystery Christmas
programme.desc: (2023) Festive rom com with Brittany Bristow. Reporter Leslie teams up with local detective Preston to catch a Christmas display thief, but as they follow the clues will love be the real story?

programme.title: A Rose For Christmas
programme.desc: An artist commissioned to build a float for the annual Rose Parade clashes with a company executive.

programme.title: Tailor-Made Romance
programme.desc: A struggling designer takes a job as a personal stylist for a grumpy but ridiculously handsome billionaire. As she revamps his wardrobe and he teaches her about business, they realize they just might be the perfect fit.

programme.title: Made for You, with Love
programme.desc: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Home Again
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon stars as Alice Kinney in HOME AGAIN a modern and heartwarming romantic comedy. Recently separated from her husband (Michael Sheen, Passengers), Alice decides to start over and move back to Los Angeles with her two young daughters as she struggles to get a new career off the ground.

programme.title: How to Find Forever
programme.desc: Marley's brilliant at organizing other people's engagements, but unlucky in finding romance herself. When designing her most important proposal yet, the man who could jeopardize it all may be the one who helps find her own love story.

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: A tale of forbidden romance and changing social conventions, "My Policeman" follows the relationships between three people — policeman Tom, teacher Marion and museum curator Patrick — and their emotional and complex journey that spans decades.

programme.title: Christmas Together
programme.desc: A woman leaves New York for LA after a break-up and falls in love while renting the guest house of a young father.

programme.title: An Evergreen Christmas
programme.desc: Evie Lee returns to her hometown for her father's funeral, facing family debt and tough choices between her music career and saving the family's tree farm.

programme.title: Nicholas Nickleby (2002)
programme.desc: After Nicholas' father dies and leaves the family penniless, the Nickleby Family moves to London to stay with their Uncle Ralph. Ralph turns abusive and separates the family.

programme.title: The Loss Adjuster
programme.desc: Hapless Insurance Loss Adjuster - Martin Dyer - feels his life is spiralling out of control but discovers that even when you reach rock bottom, that some clouds really do have a silver lining.

programme.title: Art Of Falling In Love
programme.desc: An artist painting a mural on a new hospital wing falls for the project's architect but worries he may not want to be with her if she reveals the unfortunate story behind her secret bucket list.

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: After winning a $50,000 prize, a man decides to pay things forward by buying Christmas gifts for strangers under the pseudonym "Lucky the Elf."

programme.title: A Christmas Wish
programme.desc: Abandoned by her husband a few days before Christmas, Martha Evans travels cross-country with the kids in search of work.

programme.title: A Toast to Love
programme.desc: A marine archeologist finds wine in a shipwreck. If she hopes to save her research program she must discover the love story behind the wine.

programme.title: Eve's Christmas
programme.desc: Busy ad executive on the brink of partnership rethinks her life choices.

programme.title: Christmas Town
programme.desc: Cynical workaholic suspects her dad's sudden switch to a Christmas-obsessed town.

programme.title: The Ugly Christmas Sweater
programme.desc: Megan hunts for top Christmas hashtag to wow boss and crush at work.

programme.title: Reindeer Games Homecoming
programme.desc: MacKenzie competes in "The Reindeer Games" keep her father's tradition alive.

programme.title: Baby Obsession
programme.desc: Years after losing her child under a sitter's watch Raquel seeks revenge upon learning the sitter is pregnant.

programme.title: Fatal Defense
programme.desc: A single mother signs up for self-defense classes from a handsome instructor. But he develops a frightening obsession with her and orchestrates an increasing deadly array of "tests" to see if she has truly learned from his lessons.

programme.title: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: Laura Paddington is overcome with joy when her daughter, Zoe, returns to her after being abducted 17 years before--but is Zoe really her long lost child?

programme.title: Running Away
programme.desc: Sisters Maggie and Lizzie move in with mom Peg's new husband. Secrets and lies start immediately. Maggie cannot handle what follows and recruits a friend to help her plan to get out of town with her step father's secrets. When Peg discovers that her daughter has run away, she now has to find Maggie fast but must come to terms with the dark secrets that led to Maggie's fleeing and the secrets about her new husband.

programme.title: Paul Blart
programme.desc: In Columbia Pictures' comedy Paul Blart: Mall Cop, Kevin James stars as the title character, a single, suburban dad, trying to make ends meet as a security officer at a New Jersey mall. Though no one else takes his job seriously, Paul considers himself on the front lines of safety. When a heist shuts down the megaplex, Jersey's most formidable mall cop will have to become a real cop to save the day.

programme.title: Paul Blart
programme.desc: After six years of keeping our malls safe, Paul Blart (Kevin James) has earned a vacation. He heads to Vegas with his teenage daughter and finds that safety never takes a holiday. When duty calls, Blart answers.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) meets the girl of his dreams (Brooklyn Decker) but has to enlist his loyal assistant Katherine (Jennifer Aniston) to pretend to be his soon-to-be ex-wife in order to cover up a careless lie. When more lies backfire, Katherine's kids become involved, and everyone heads off to Hawaii for a ridiculous, out-of-control weekend that tests the limits of how far we'll go for love.

programme.title: Dog Days
programme.desc: “What is it about dogs that brings us so much joy?” Lives are about to change forever, when human and canine paths intertwine in sunny Los Angeles. There's Elizabeth, a news anchor in her 30's, who not only having to deal with a bad breakup, is struggling to cheer up her depressed dog Sam.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Lauren Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all romantic relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: Isabella, a young Hollywood starlet, recalls how the actions of charming Broadway director, Arnold, changed her life forever.

programme.title: Straight Up
programme.desc: A gay OCD twentysomething finds his intellectual soul mate in a struggling actress.

programme.title: The Capture
programme.desc: A badly injured fugitive explains to a priest how he came to be in his present predicament.

programme.title: Canadian Pacific
programme.desc: A surveyor for the Canadian Pacific Railroad must fight fur trappers who oppose the building of the railroad by stirring up Indian rebellion.

programme.title: Bastard, Go and Kill
programme.desc: Chaco, a Mexican on the run from just about everyone, is framed for the killing of a couple of cattlemen.

programme.title: Man, Pride & Vengeance
programme.desc: A stalwart Spanish soldier turns to a life of crime to prove his love for a mysterious and promiscuous gypsy woman.

programme.title: Personal Affair
programme.desc: When a teenaged student disappears, her teacher is suspected of killing her.

programme.title: Portrait From Life
programme.desc: Major Lawrence wanders into an art gallery and is struck by the beauty of a young girl in a painting.

programme.title: Proud Valley
programme.desc: David Goliath, an unemployed stoker from a Cardiff, is making his way up the Welsh valleys in search of work.

programme.title: Rome Express
programme.desc: A tense story of robbery, intrigue and murder which takes place on a trans-continental train.

programme.title: Behind The Line
programme.desc: Occupied France, 1940. A Nazi Commander discovers one of his prisoners, Danny (Sam Gittins) is a champion boxer. He forces him to fight for his companies entertainment.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The citizens of Spokane, a small town in Washington state, awaken to the sight of North Korean paratroopers dropping from the sky. The U.S.A. has been invaded and their hometown is the initial target. Without warning, the town is unable to fight back and finds itself under enemy occupation.

programme.title: Miracles: The Canton Godfather
programme.desc: A country boy becomes the head of a gang through the purchase of some lucky roses from an old lady. He and a singer at the gang's nightclub try to do a good deed for the old lady when her daughter comes to visit.

programme.title: Kill The Irishman
programme.desc: Oscar®-winner Christopher Walken, Val Kilmer, and Ray Stevenson star in KILL THE IRISHMAN, the true story of a tough Irish thug working for mobsters in Cleveland during the 1970s.

programme.title: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 AD: an artifact called Gunther's Scepter is sealed in a vault. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney and Nigel are hired to find it using a crystal and a stone tablet.

programme.title: The Executioners Mask
programme.desc: When a model's face is disfigured after she puts on the mask of a French executioner, Sydney and Nigel will try and find the tomb to reverse the curse.

programme.title: The Royal Ring
programme.desc: When the British Museum gets Sidney and Nigel to help search at Tudor sites for a ring of King Henry VIII, Nigel is confronted with his self-confident pestering elder brother Preston Bailey.

programme.title: Set in Stone
programme.desc: In a monastery, Knight Gabriel impales a demon, which then turns to stone. In 2001, Nigel and Sydney arrive bearing a letter from a monk, but the abbot claims it is a forgery and shuts them out.

programme.title: Deadline
programme.desc: Allan comes to Sydney, telling he has 12 hours before a Necron virus kills him unless he delivers Tau to a blackmailer who has the antidote.

programme.title: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 BC: The Chinese invent an explosive gift egg. New York, 2001: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to a map leading to the Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Vampires Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, a babe-magnet, professor and a novelist asks Sydney to help find Vlad Tepes' lost relic. And he isn't the only one after it.

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney runs into her ex Gray and goes on a holiday with him to Bali, but when Derek Lloyd shows up to enlist her to find Parvati's Bowl, she can't resist.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Deeply ensconced in a top-secret military program, three pilots struggle to bring an artificial intelligence program under control ... before it initiates the next world war.

programme.title: Wild Things II
programme.desc: Keeping your friends close and your enemies closer has never been more important...or more dangerous. The girls of Blue Bay are back, and they're wilder than ever in this seductive sequel where no one is innocent and nothing is what it appears to be.

programme.title: The Forgotten (2004)
programme.desc: Haunted by the memories of a son her husband swears she never had, a distraught mother's search for the truth leads to a mind-shattering conspiracy of unearthly terror.

programme.title: The Devil's Own
programme.desc: Harrison Ford and Brad Pitt co-star in Alan J. Pakula's hit about about a New York cop and an Irishterrorist who face the ultimate danger when their lives intersect.

programme.title: A Little Trip to Heaven
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Abraham Holt travels to a tiny town in rural Minnesota to look into a particularly unusual insurance claim stemming from a horrific car accident. As Holt examines the scene of the wreck, it all seems a bit too perfect. And when he interviews Isold McBride and her shifty husband, Fred -- the impoverished beneficiaries of the massive, recently initiated life-insurance policy -- he begins to suspect that something is amiss.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Two estranged sisters are forced to rob a bank in order to save their brother. The heist begins smoothly, but mayhem ensues when the defiant bank manager sends them to a basement-level vault.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: On their way home from China, married Christian missionaries Roy (Woody Harrelson) and Jessie (Emily Mortimer) take a train from Beijing to Moscow. On board, they befriend Carlos (Eduardo Noriega) and Abby (Kate Mara). When Roy does not return in time at one stop, Jessie waits for him to catch up at the next station. Carlos and Abby stay with her, insisting the town is unsafe, however Carlos' attempts to "befriend" Jessie radically change the dynamic of the trip.

programme.title: Agent Red [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Captain Matt Hendricks and Dr. Linda Christian are locked in a submarine with Russian terrorists that threaten to launch a chemical virus on US territory.

programme.title: Cover-Up [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

programme.title: The Final Stand [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Cadets from the Podolsk infantry and artillery schools are sent to fight alongside units from the Soviet 43rd Army outside Moscow in 1941, holding back the German advance.

programme.title: Un Noël presque royal!
programme.desc: La famille royale demande à un ouvrier jardinier de se faire passer pour un comte qui s'est enfui des années auparavant.

programme.title: Un Noël saupoudré d'amour
programme.desc: Une cadre de Los Angeles se rend dans une petite ville durant les fêtes pour organiser la vente d'une propriété lui appartenant.

programme.title: Un souhait magique pour Noël
programme.desc: Après une journée de travail particulièrement décourageante à la boutique de souvenirs de son quartier, Renée fait le vœu de changer de vie.

programme.title: Un merveilleux Noël en famille
programme.desc: Deux frères adoptés par différentes familles se retrouvent à Noël et une étincelle naît entre leurs parents respectifs.

programme.title: Noël au ranch
programme.desc: Une nounou revient chez elle pour Noël et vit une histoire de romance et de secondes chances.

programme.title: Boots Malone
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck agent and an aspiring jockey team up to seek fame and fortune at the track.

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: A swordsmith becomes a knight in order to avenge the death of his master and marry a nobleman's daughter.

programme.title: The Daring Young Man
programme.desc: An army reject inadvertently stumbles into the middle of a Nazi spy ring.

programme.title: All Ashore
programme.desc: A trio of sailor's are sidetracked by a robbery until one of them gets a job that leads him to a heiress.

programme.title: The Taming Of The Shrew
programme.desc: A daughter is stunned when her father announces that she cannot marry until her sister does.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Donovan's Echo
programme.desc: After he discovers events from his past are repeating, Donovan (Danny Glover) is convinced his young neighbor and her mother will die on the same day his wife and daughter were killed 30 years ago.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman.

programme.title: Trespass

programme.title: Ahmad Jamal Trio
programme.sub-title: Ahmad Jamal Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, legendary jazz pianist Ahmad Jamal brought his trio to the North Sea Jazz Festival. Accompanied by James Cammack on bass and David Bowler on drums, Jamal showcased his excellence.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Seun Kuti
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti's legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent. Three-quarters of Egypt 80's current line-up is composed of musicians who didn't only play with Fela Kuti, but often were arrested and harassed alongside the founder of the Afrobeat.

programme.title: Benny Goodman, Scott Hamilton, John Bunch & Phil Flanigan
programme.sub-title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet. The “King of Swing” revisited the atmosphere of the 1930s, when jazz enjoyed tremendous popularity.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Thomas Dunford
programme.sub-title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995 Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007 and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. Paris-born lutenist Thomas Dunford (*1988) discovered the lute at the age of nine. He studied at the Conservatory of Paris and the Schola Cantorum in Basel, and participated in masterclasses with lutenists such as Rolf Lislevand and Julian Bream. He has made various solo and ensemble appearances at Europe's most prestigious festivals.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet's music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Supertramp
programme.desc: Supertramp's “Breakfast In America” was the biggest selling album in the world in 1979. It spawned several hit singles and went on to win two Grammy Awards and sell in excess of 20 million copies. Following the album's release Supertramp embarked on a 10 month world tour which arrived in Paris at the end of November. This show from the Pavillon de Paris was both filmed and recorded and now for the first time the full length audio and the concert film are combined in one set. The concert features the different song-writing styles of Roger Hodgson and Rick Davies, who each composed the songs on which they sing lead vocals.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Blondie
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Blondie performs her hits including ''Heart of Glass", "Euphoria", ''Mile High" and many more…

programme.title: Jethro Tull
programme.desc: Jethro Tull is one of the most successful British acts of all time with a career reaching from the late sixties to the present day. In 2003 they made their first (and so far only) visit to the Montreux Festival. Split into a semi-acoustic first half and a full on electric second half, the concert was a triumph combining newer songs such as “Dot Com”, “Pavane” and “Budapest” with classic favorites. As ever Ian Anderson leads from the front with his instantly recognizable voice and inimitable style of one-legged flute playing. programme.desc: Frances, la ex-esposa de Jake, conspira con sus hijos, para obligarlo a vender su amado equipo de baloncesto de Seattle. ¿Será que el juego sale de la cancha para encender chispas románticas?

programme.title: Secretos Enterrados
programme.desc: Sarah es una antigua policía que acaba de publicar una novela con éxito, la cual desvela la causa de la muerte de un confidente de la policía.

programme.title: Buen funeral, amigos… paga Sartana
programme.desc: Tras presenciar una brutal matanza de una familia de mineros, el legendario héroe Sartana se dispone a investigar. Casi todo el…

programme.title: La reina de Nueva York
programme.desc: Wally Cook es un reportero que está siempre al acecho de noticias que puedan atraer al lector. En su búsqueda encuentra la historia de Hazel Flagg, una chica que ha estado expuesta a radiación y a la que solo dan seis semanas de vida.

programme.title: Más allá de la duda
programme.desc: Un escritor intenta demostrar la deficiencia de las leyes y la ineficacia de la policía, colocando falsas pruebas contra sí mismo en un caso de asesinato.

programme.title: Senso
programme.desc: Venecia, 1866. Livia, una bella dama de una aristocrática familia italiana, vive un intenso romance con el teniente Franz Mahler, un oficial del ejército ATco, en plena guerra de independencia italiana frente a AT.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Una noche, James Ballard estrella su coche contra el de Helen y ambos son ingresados en un hospital. Lo sorprendente es que inmediatamente después del choque los dos experimentaron una extraña atracción mutua. A partir de entonces, la vida de James se precipitará hacia un mundo oscuro y prohibido, dominado por el peligro, el sexo y la muerte.

programme.title: Recuerdo
programme.desc: Gordon inventa la máquina "Rememory" que le permite ver los recuerdos tal y como fueron en realidad.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: La carrera
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Revuelo en las Aulas
programme.desc: Estudiantes de secundaria se unen contra la censura de un director opresivo.

programme.title: Guyana
programme.desc: La costa desconocida de Guyana, el reino del hoatzín y del pez de cuatro ojos

programme.title: Donde está el Truco
programme.desc: Arturo hereda un circo en quiebra y dos niños —uno con superpoderes—, cambiando y salvando su vida.

programme.title: Vidas Criminales
programme.desc: Secuestro se complica cuando el esposo no paga.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Rockero rescata a su esposa secuestrada en Chile.

programme.title: Sin rastro
programme.desc: Frenético thriller lleno de persecuciones sin tregua protagonizado por Amanda Seyfried ('In time'). Jill Parrish regresa a su casa después de pasar la noche trabajando y descubre que su hermana ha sido raptada. Jill sospecha que el secuestrador es el mismo que la atormentó a ella años atrás.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: John Turturro y Woody Allen firman esta mirada extraña, conmovedora y divertid a un peculiar grupo de neoyorquinos. Fioravante decide hacerse gigoló para sacar algún dinero con el que ayudar a su amigo Murray, que está sin blanca.

programme.title: Amor y otras drogas
programme.desc: Maggie es una mujer independiente que no deja que nada le ate. Pero conoce a Jamie, cuyo encanto le sirve bien tanto con las mujeres como dentro del mundo de las farmacéuticas. La evolución que sufre su relación coge a ambos por sorpresa, al encontrarse bajo la influencia de la droga final: el amor.

programme.title: El Benefactor
programme.desc: La historia de un nostálgico filántropo (Richard Gere) que se involucra y se hace hueco en la vida de un matrimonio recién casado, Olivia (Dakota Fanning) y Luke (Theo James), buscando con ello recuperar experiencias vitales que antaño tuvo.

programme.title: El gran partido
programme.desc: Los nazis organizan un partido de fútbol entre un equipo de reclusos del campo y un equipo nazi de élite en el cumpleaños de Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Un diseñador de coches se enfrenta a toda la industria automovilística con sus revolucionarios diseños.

programme.title: Pájaros de verano
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real que explica el origen del narcotráfico en Colombia, la película se sitúa en los años 70 cuando la juventud norteamericana abraza la cultura hippie y con ella a la marihuana. Esto provoca que los agricultores de la zona se conviertan en “empresarios” a un ritmo veloz.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: Todo es relativo
programme.desc: Harry ama a Grace, pero un secreto familiar convierte su historia de amor en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Un Puñado de Polvo
programme.desc: Lady Brenda, hastiada de su vida, inicia un romance que sacude los cimientos de su mundo.

programme.title: Un hombre solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo cincuentón y venido a menos intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo, han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Perdido en Florencia
programme.desc: Eric Lombard es un americano con el corazón roto en una fase de su vida en la que tras tomar varias decisiones, decide viajar a Florencia. Allí tratará de descifrar que es lo que más desea, si seguir jugando al fútbol y continuar con su antiguo amor o darle un cambio de rumbo a su vida.

programme.title: La vida sin ti
programme.desc: Laurent Larivière vuelve con un enigmático drama que desvela lentamente el misterio de la vida de una mujer, interpretada por Isabelle Huppert, mientras rememora los recuerdos más felices y oscuros de su vida, entre Francia, Irlanda y Alemania.

programme.title: Mi segunda vez
programme.desc: La ganadora de un Oscar Catherine Zeta-Jones (“Chicago”) da vida a una mujer que, tras descubrir que su marido la engaña, se va a Nueva York y allí se enamora de un joven que le hará descubrir que las segundas oportunidades existen.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: Un manitas con problemas matrimoniales se encuentra con un ama de casa con los mismos.

programme.title: Dos mujeres
programme.desc: Claire es una maravillosa comadrona con un talento natural para traer niños al mundo. Pero con los años su tierna y delicada artesanía es cuestionada por los más eficientes y modernos métodos de los hospitales. Un día recibe una llamada de Béatrice, la frívola ex amante de su fallecido padre, que quiere verla con urgencia tras 30 años de mutua indiferencia. Su encuentro conducirá a la revelación de ciertos secretos que darán sentido a una parte importante de sus vidas.

programme.title: Como el buen vino
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo experimenta una crisis ética y viaja de regreso a su pueblo natal en el sur de Italia tras 45 años de ausencia para recalibrar su vida. Allí encuentra un nuevo propósito en revivir el antiguo viñedo de su abuelo, ofrecerle al pequeño pueblo de Acerenza un futuro sostenible y reconectar con su familia en el proceso.

programme.title: Kabei. Nuestra madre
programme.desc: Tokio, 1940. La familia Nogami vive feliz en una paz inusitada. Sin embargo, el patriarca es detenido y acusado de comunista. Su esposa Kayo se ve obligada a trabajar frenéticamente para poder dar de comer a sus dos hijas con el apoyo de Hisako, la hermana de su esposo. La Segunda Guerra Mundial arroja horribles y fatídicas noticias pero Kayo todavía guarda una última esperanza de que su marido regrese algún día.

programme.title: Palabras suaves
programme.desc: Connie Wyatt es una chica de quince años de espíritu libre que vuelve locos a los chicos. Su madre quiere mantenerla a salvo en casa, pero Connie prefiere pasar los lánguidos días de verano con sus amigos y coqueteando con hombres. Pero cuando un día flirtea con un guapo y peligroso desconocido llamado Arnold Friend, deberá prepararse para las aterradoras y traumáticas consecuencias.

programme.title: Deal
programme.desc: Un ex-jugador enseña a un chico a jugar a las cartas y se involucra en las Series Mundiales de Póquer.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: La noche del viernes es casi como una Nochevieja, llena de sorpresas y con su propia magia especial.

programme.title: El Legado Absoluto
programme.desc: ¡El capítulo final de la trilogía! Esta conclusión muestra que si aprendemos algo, cambiamos nuestra vida.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos cambian cuando el profesor de filosofía es confundido un traficante de drogas.

programme.title: Oficina Zombie
programme.desc: Un empleado de una fábrica descubre que una bebida energética convierte a sus compañeros en zombis.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Memorias de un hombre invisible
programme.desc: Un experimento del Gobierno fracasa y vuelve invisible a un testigo casual.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Desesperado por una buena historia, un periodista adicto al sexo se sumerge en el mundo de las señoritas de compañía de lujo cuando comienza a seguirle los pasos a una prostituta licenciada en Stanford.

programme.title: Uncle Drew
programme.desc: Un joven propietario de un equipo y Uncle Drew (Kyrie Irving, estrella de la NBA) reúnen al antiguo equipo de baloncesto de Drew para demostrar que un grupo de septuagenarios todavía puede triunfar.

programme.title: Pieles
programme.desc: En un extraño mundo en que la humanidad es deforme, todos buscan a quien les acepte tal como son. Sigue la historia de personas físicamente diferentes que, por este motivo, se han visto obligadas a esconderse, recluirse o unirse entre ellas.

programme.title: El Pelotón Chiflado
programme.desc: Cuando John Winger pierde su apartamento, su novia y su trabajo en un mismo día, hace lo que cualquier americano que se precie: se alista en el ejército y casi provoca la 3ª Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: The Animal (2001)
programme.desc: Puede que no parezca mucho, pero lo que cuenta está dentro. El genio de la comedia Rob Schneider (Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo, Big Daddy), Colleen Haskell del concurso de televisión Survivor, John C. McGinley (Any Given Sunday, The Rock) y Edward Asner (The Bachelor, JFK) aparecen en la comedia más escandalosa e histérica del año. Cuando el guardia de seguridad Marvin Mange (Schneider) responde a una llamada de emergencia sobre un robo en progreso, su sueño de convertirse en policía podría convertirse en realidad. Pero un extraño accidente de tráfico en su camino al lugar del crimen deja a Martin y a su sueño destrozados. Cuando Marvin se despierta una semana después, descubre que un científico desquiciado secretamente ha usado órganos de animales para reconstruir su cuerpo. Con nuevas energías gracias a sus nuevas y mejoradas partes, Marvin consigue fama al instante como superpolicía hasta que su instinto animal empieza a apoderarse de su cuerpo en los peores momentos. Y cuando se enamora de la encantadora y sexy Rianna (Haskell), ¡es magnetismo animal en su máxima expresión en la comedia más divertida y salvaje del año! No te pierdas a Rob Schneider en Big Daddy.

programme.title: Un Funeral De Muerte
programme.desc: Death at a Funeral cuenta la divertidísima jornada de una familia estadounidense que se reúne para el entierro de un adorado marido y padre. A medida que llegan los dolientes a la casa paterna, una serie de revelaciones escandalosas, profundos resentimientos, feas amenazas, chantajes y un cadáver equivocado desatan el caos más letal y descontrolado.

programme.title: Bad Teacher
programme.desc: Cuando su prometido la deja, una profesora de instituto malhablada, grosera e irresponsable pone sus ojos en un rico y guapo compañero de trabajo, algo que la enfrenta a una profesora modélica.

programme.title: La Cruda Realidad
programme.desc: Para conseguir al hombre perfecto tendrá que escuchar al peor de todos

programme.title: La promesa del pistolero
programme.desc: El antiguo sheriff asesina por accidente a un hombre mientras intentaba dar caza al asesino de su familia. Austin promete entregar el cuerpo a la hermana del fallecido y confesar que fue el culpable.

programme.title: Llanto por un bandido
programme.desc: José María "El Tempranillo" huye de la justicia y se esconde en Sierra Morena. Allí, tras enfrentarse a peligros y desafíos, forja su destino como líder de un temido grupo de bandidos. De perseguido a leyenda, su nombre se convertirá en símbolo de rebeldía y aventura.

programme.title: Relevo para un pistolero
programme.desc: Un desconocido de Boston ofrece a un notorio ex forajido de Arizona un trabajo que no puede rechazar.

programme.title: Pintura de guerra
programme.desc: El teniente Billings debe entregar un tratado de paz al jefe Gray Cloud en nueve días o habrá guerra. Guiados por Taslik, hijo del jefe, enfrentan la sed y crecientes tensiones. Pero algo no encaja: Taslik lleva pintura de guerra. ¿Realmente los conduce a la paz o a una emboscada?

programme.title: La batalla de los rancheros
programme.desc: Antigua película del Oeste protagonizada por Brian Donlevy: La batalla de los rancheros - Las disputas por la propiedad de un hombre muerto se convierten en una sangrienta guerra en el campo.

programme.title: Los Nadies
programme.desc: En medio de la cordillera de los Andes hay un gran vertedero. Cientos de personas sin hogar viven de la basura. El gobierno local envía a un inexperto trabajador social a evacuar estas zonas y el conflicto estalla.

programme.title: El Dorado y la Ciudad de Oro
programme.desc: Jack y María descubren una pista hacia El Dorado, pero su hallazgo amenaza poderosos intereses. Un oscuro consorcio teme el colapso del mercado del oro y envía a un mercenario para detenerlos, convirtiendo la aventura en una peligrosa persecución.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y la búsqueda de la tumba de Akhenaten
programme.desc: Jack Hunter es secuestrado por la NSA para buscar la otra parte del arma de Osiris en Giza. Junto a Lena y sus amigos sirios, enfrenta a una secta midianita, a un coronel ambicioso y a peligros mortales mientras descifra pistas ugaríticas hacia el tesoro de la tumba del faraón.

programme.title: Executor
programme.desc: Un despiadado asesino, entrenado para matar en nombre de Dios por un sacerdote corrupto, reevalúa el propósito de su vida después de salvar a un niño pequeño de uno de sus propios intentos de asesinato.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: Hijos de la medianoche
programme.desc: En la medianoche del 15 de agosto de 1947, el mismo día en que la India consiguió la independencia, Saleem y Shiva nacieron en el mismo hospital de Bombay y formaron parte de la primera generación libre del país. La historia de Saleem y Shiva, intercambiados en sus cunas al nacer, tiene como transfondo la convulsa historia de la India moderna, desde su independencia hasta los años ochenta: poderes sobrenaturales, amores prohibidos y secretos de familia se entremezclan con guerras y golpes de estado.

programme.title: The Princess Blade
programme.desc: Yuki pertenece a un grupo de guerreros mercenarios, los Takemikazuchi, largamente empleados por el actual gobierno para vencer a la facción rebelde contrarios a su política déspota. Esta banda de samurais modernos se rige por un sólido código del honor mas cercano a las antiguas ordenes feudales que a una organización pseudo-criminal. Yuki, descendiente directa de la rama consanguínea de los fundadores del clan descubrirá que su madre fue asesinada por el actual dirigente del mismo cuando intentó poner fin a las maniobras de sus miembros. Consciente de ello Yuki se volverá contra sus camaradas y tendrá que liberarse de sus deberes para ser libre.

programme.title: Mi amigo Blue
programme.desc: Una icónica historia de amistad entre un muchacho y un perro único y desgarbado que se convertiría en una leyenda australiana.

programme.title: La espina de Dios
programme.desc: Un pequeño grupo de hombres comienza a predicar la próxima venida del Reino. Su líder, el rabí Jesús de Nazaret insufla ilusión en los corazones, su mensaje es de amor y esperanza, aunque no todos supieron comprenderlo.

programme.title: María (y los demás)
programme.desc: Desde que murió su madre, María ha cuidado de su padre y de sus hermanos. Responsable y controladora, siempre ha sido el pilar de la familia y se siente orgullosa de ello. Por eso, cuando su padre anuncia que se casa con Cachita, su simpática enfermera, María siente que su mundo se desmorona.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: Amar
programme.desc: Una de las óperas primas más estimulantes y reveladoras del año. El talento de Esteban Crespo, nominado al Oscar por el cortometraje "Aquel no era yo" se confirma con esta película de amores tan intensos que se viven como si cada día fuera el último.

programme.title: Myway
programme.desc: Cuando un maton de poca monta arruina un negocio de drogas, se encuentra en problemas con algunos jefes de la mafia muy peligrosos, sin mencionar a su propia esposa e hija. Este crudo drama criminal sigue al gangster mientras intenta corregir sus dos desastres.

programme.title: Los misterios de Fixer Upper
programme.desc: Durante la renovación de una casa antigua Shannon Hughes descubre algo sorprendente: los huesos de una adolescente que desapareció hace quince años.

programme.title: Experiment
programme.desc: A man and woman walk the streets of a foreign city with no memory of who they are and plagued by nightmarish visions. Unknown to them their every action is being guided by unseen forces from the dark underground shadows of the city.

programme.title: Point Defiance
programme.desc: A bachelor's beautiful, isolated home becomes a hostile prison when his troubled brother returns from military duty in Afghanistan, forcing them to unearth their violent past before another dark secret is buried.

programme.title: Corrupción policial
programme.desc: Un policía negro descubre una célula de vigilantes supremacistas blancos dentro de su departamento.

programme.title: Kill 'Em All
programme.desc: Tras un tiroteo masivo, un misterioso desconocido (Van Damme) llega a un hospital local al borde de la muerte. Entonces, una banda extranjera se presenta descaradamente al hospital para cazarlo. Su enfermera, la única testigo superviviente del tiroteo posterior, debe enfrentarse a un interrogatorio del FBI que desvela una trama de intriga y venganza internacional. Con suficientes giros inesperados, KILL'EM ALL te mantendrá en vilo hasta el último disparo.

programme.title: AVH: Alien vs. Hunter : NE PAS UTILISER CAR MIRE
programme.desc: Un cazador galáctico persigue a su presa más mortífera del universo.

programme.title: Battledogs
